notes.capped: Predictions and training targets are capped at 125; 'capped truth' applies the same cap to the official RUL values so both sides share a scale.
notes.raw: Raw-truth metrics compare capped predictions with uncapped official RULs; they are reported for transparency (engines with true RUL > cap are under-predicted by construction).
notes.test_usage: Official test set evaluated once, after model selection, at the final cycle of each engine.
